candidates.reason: Proper vertical restack: can, then headline, subcopy and CTA in a clear top-to-bottom order with readable text. Flaws: the Q logo is demoted to a tiny badge jammed into the bottom-left corner, so the brand ends the reading order and sits off every axis. The large decorative circle crowds the top-left and nearly touches the can. The left-aligned headline and the centred CTA don't share an edge.

Good recomposition of the parts, but the Quillbrook logo is blown up to about four times its original size and competes with the 'Chase the light' headline. The deco circle overlaps the logo ring at the top right. The left-aligned logo and headline clash with the centred can. 'Sparkling botanicals' is shrunk to small text and squeezed beside the CTA at the bottom edge, and a large empty band sits around the can.

The logo is scaled up hugely and becomes the dominant focal point, larger in visual weight than the headline, which breaks brand proportion and hierarchy. The deco circle collides with the logo's top-right edge. The subcopy is demoted to small two-line text crammed next to the Shop Now button at the bottom edge, and the can floats in dead space mid-canvas.

Just the original square layout shrunk and dropped into the middle of the tall canvas. The top and bottom thirds are empty brown, the headline, subcopy, CTA and logo are tiny, and the side-by-side banner arrangement ignores the story format. It isn't rearranged and wastes most of the space.
